defs.def: to give sb the right to have or to do sth 使享有权利；使符合资格

ex.s: BEthnic minority groups in China are often entitled to special funds from the government to help protect their cultural heritage.
ex.t: 中国的少数民族群体通常有权从政府获得特别资金，以帮助保护他们的文化遗产。

defs.def: to give a title to a book, play, etc. 给 … 命名（或题名）

ex.s: While in exile in 1045, Fan wrote an essay entitled Memorial to Yueyang Tower.
ex.t: 1045 年流放期间，范仲淹写了一篇题为《岳阳楼记》的文章。

ex.s: The drawing is entitled"It's Time to Waterthe Flowers".
ex.t: 这幅画的标题是“该给花浇水了”。

ex.s: He was fascinated by Li Bai's poems and translated some of them in his 1915 poetry collection entitled Cathay.
ex.t: 他深深着迷于李白的诗歌，并在其 1915 年的诗集《华夏集》中翻译了其中一些。
